SystemStory.title: Designed for the day something breaks.
SystemStory.copy: Event-driven services on Kafka and RabbitMQ: how I design them to keep their promises when parts of the system fail.
SystemStory.label: A Kafka topic with idempotent consumers, a saga and a trace

log.title: Events, not calls
log.body: Orders are written once to a partitioned Kafka log; services read at their own pace.

idempotent.title: Safe to deliver twice
idempotent.body: Consumers are idempotent: a redelivered event is recognised by its key and skipped.

failure.title: Failure has a plan
failure.body: Payment trips a circuit breaker; the saga publishes a compensation and stock is released.

trace.title: One trace, end to end
trace.body: Every hop carries the same trace, so production questions get answers, not guesses.
